comment: Référentiel of the veille: law references a register can hold (kind, number, date, title, domain) and when they apply (conditions of lib/registre/profil.ts). The summary of requirements and the risk are written by the consultant in each register. Texts found in the JORT are added by lib/registre/referentiel.ts.
